Maya Ryu: Quick async check — staging VPC connector for customer Nebula is scheduled for cutover Tue 09:00 PT. We need an explicit egress fallback for the private deployment (customer is airgapped-ish). Current blockers I know of: firewall outbound allowlist, prober not runnable in airgap, and NAT gateway flakiness. Who owns each? :eyes:

René Cortez: I can own the firewall allowlist. Need the final FQDN/IP list and which ports to open. Can someone confirm whether we'll use DNS allowlist or IPs?

Ashwin Patel: I’ll own the prober/healthchecks. For airgapped staging we planned an internal prober that hits the local proxy + checksum of cached manifests. I have a failing case where the prober gets HTTP 429 from the caching proxy under load. Repro steps: ```bash
curl -sS -I http://local-cache.internal/manifest | head -n 1
# returns 429 intermittently
```

Sophia Larson: NAT gateway flakiness = infra ticket INF-721. Netops saw packet drops during large pulls. ETA for mitigation (ephemeral NAT pool split) is tomorrow EOD.

René Cortez: FQDN list v0: `api.redwood-inference.com`, `updates.redwood-inference.net`, `kms.customer-region.example` — port 443. Prefer DNS allowlist with short TTLs so we can rotate. If customer mandates IPs we can provide after we confirm egress IP pools.

Maya Ryu: Thanks René. Customer wants IPs for audit; acceptable to provide a rolling list if we document rotation window. Ashwin — can you make the prober fallback to checksum-only mode when 429s appear? That would avoid false negatives.

Ashwin Patel: Yep. I’ll add a quick circuit: on >=3 429s within 10s switch to checksum-only for 5m, then retry full check. Pushing a branch now: `feature/prober-airgap-fallback`. Ping me for CR.

deploy-bot: deploy job #6543 started by @Maya Ryu for `staging-vpc-connector` — stage: infra-checks -> pending

Sophia Larson: Netops Bot confirmed NAT mitigation plan, splitting ephemeral pools to reduce contention. Will monitor after change. I’ll update INF-721 with post-change telemetry thresholds.

Netops Bot: NAT pool split scheduled in 2h. Will emit event when complete.

Maya Ryu: Concrete owners & action items: René = firewall allowlist + final IP list (blocker: need confirmation of egress IPs by EOD today); Ashwin = prober fallback + PR for CR today; Sophia = NAT mitigation + monitor INF-721. I'll draft the customer runbook for the cutover and link to this thread. Next async check-in: 18:00 PT today. If any blocker remains at 18:00 we escalate to oncall for temporary routing fallback. :thumbsup:
